dialogues.speaker: Younan
dialogues.text: Hmm? Are you one of the contestants in Warrior's Spirit?

dialogues.speaker: Younan
dialogues.text: Yes. We Eremites are tasked with ensuring safe passage of goods from Inazuma to Sumeru, which is why we often come to Ritou.

dialogues.speaker: Younan
dialogues.text: You can sign up for this Warrior's Spirit contest as long as you have a weapon for close-quarters combat. How could I say no?

dialogues.speaker: Younan
dialogues.text: Hah, not that I'm bragging, but my brothers at Port Ormos are famous for their martial prowess, and I'm the best out of them all!

dialogues.speaker: Younan
dialogues.text: #It seems that you know your way around a sword, {M#young man}{F#young lady}, but you do look a little... frail. If we see each other on the field, don't blame me for not going easy, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Younan
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's you! I didn't think I would lose to a {M#young man}{F#young woman} with scrawny arms and legs! But you're a real fighter, so it was an honorable loss, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will you stick around in Inazuma?

dialogues.speaker: Younan
dialogues.text: What? Just because I lost doesn't mean I can't stay here! ...Well, to tell you the truth, I've been waiting these last two days for the next cargo ship that my brothers are on to come and take me home.

dialogues.speaker: Younan
dialogues.text: If I'd known I would be out in the third round, I wouldn't have asked for so many days off, and not made any money. Fortunately, I won two games before, and I still have a few pennies left after I got the money to last me the next few days.
